-- name: UpsertTradebotPositions :exec
INSERT INTO tradebot_positions (
  scope_id, symbol, strategy, timeframe, direction, qty, avg_entry_price,
  stop_price, target_price, trail_price, entry_intent_id, entry_signal_id,
  entry_bar, last_signal_id, last_bar, configuration_id, position_cycle_id,
  strategy_selection_id, execution_policy
)
SELECT
  p.scope_id, p.symbol, p.strategy, p.timeframe, p.direction, p.qty,
  p.avg_entry_price, p.stop_price, p.target_price, p.trail_price,
  p.entry_intent_id, p.entry_signal_id, p.entry_bar, p.last_signal_id,
  p.last_bar, p.configuration_id, p.position_cycle_id,
  p.strategy_selection_id, COALESCE(p.execution_policy, '{}'::jsonb)
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS p(
  scope_id text,
  symbol text,
  strategy text,
  timeframe text,
  direction text,
  qty double precision,
  avg_entry_price double precision,
  stop_price double precision,
  target_price double precision,
  trail_price double precision,
  entry_intent_id text,
  entry_signal_id bigint,
  entry_bar timestamptz,
  last_signal_id bigint,
  last_bar timestamptz,
  configuration_id bigint,
  position_cycle_id text,
  strategy_selection_id bigint,
  execution_policy jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (scope_id, symbol) DO UPDATE SET
  strategy = EXCLUDED.strategy,
  timeframe = EXCLUDED.timeframe,
  direction = EXCLUDED.direction,
  qty = EXCLUDED.qty,
  avg_entry_price = EXCLUDED.avg_entry_price,
  stop_price = EXCLUDED.stop_price,
  target_price = EXCLUDED.target_price,
  trail_price = EXCLUDED.trail_price,
  entry_intent_id = EXCLUDED.entry_intent_id,
  entry_signal_id = EXCLUDED.entry_signal_id,
  entry_bar = EXCLUDED.entry_bar,
  last_signal_id = EXCLUDED.last_signal_id,
  last_bar = EXCLUDED.last_bar,
  configuration_id = EXCLUDED.configuration_id,
  position_cycle_id = EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id,
  strategy_selection_id = EXCLUDED.strategy_selection_id,
  execution_policy = EXCLUDED.execution_policy,
  trailing_peak = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id
      OR tradebot_positions.direction IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.direction
      OR (EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id IS NULL AND (
        tradebot_positions.entry_intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.entry_intent_id
        OR tradebot_positions.entry_bar IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.entry_bar)) THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.trailing_peak END,
  initial_risk_per_share = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.initial_risk_per_share END,
  initial_target_price = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.initial_target_price END,
  favorable_peak = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.favorable_peak END,
  adaptive_profit_active = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN FALSE
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_profit_active END,
  adaptive_profit_stop = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_profit_stop END,
  adaptive_state_bar = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_state_bar END,
  updated_at = now()

-- name: ListTradebotParityFills :many
SELECT f.fill_id, i.asset_class, i.timeframe, i.reason, owner.decision_bar, f.symbol,
  owner.direction, owner.action, f.action, f.qty,
  COALESCE(f.initial_entry_price, f.price) AS entry_price, f.price AS exit_price,
  COALESCE(f.initial_entry_filled_at, owner.decision_bar) AS entry_at,
  f.filled_at AS exit_at, f.net_pnl, c.identity, e.result,
  owner.profile_hash, p.execution_profile,
  COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(p.universe), 0)::integer AS symbol_count,
  owner.intent_id, owner.qty::float8 AS requested_qty,
  COALESCE(owner.stop_price, 0)::float8 AS stop_price,
  COALESCE(owner.target_price, 0)::float8 AS target_price,
  COALESCE(p.snapshot_id, '')::text AS snapshot_id,
  COALESCE(p.policy_context->'signalEvaluation'->>'version', '') = '1' AS strict_decision,
  owner.reference_price::float8 AS reference_price,
  x.identity AS exit_identity, x.inputs AS exit_inputs,
  i.intent_id AS exit_intent_id, i.qty::float8 AS exit_qty,
  i.decision_bar AS exit_decision_bar, i.reference_price::float8 AS exit_reference_price, f.broker_order_id,
  COALESCE(f.position_cycle_id, i.position_cycle_id, '')::text AS position_cycle_id
FROM tradebot_fill_events f
JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id = f.intent_id
JOIN tradebot_intents owner ON owner.intent_id = CASE
  WHEN f.action LIKE 'open%' THEN i.intent_id ELSE COALESCE(f.position_cycle_id, i.position_cycle_id) END
  AND owner.account_id = i.account_id AND owner.broker = i.broker
  AND owner.asset_class = i.asset_class AND owner.timeframe = i.timeframe
JOIN signals s ON s.id = owner.signal_id
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT identity, evaluation_hash FROM tradebot_parity_contracts c
  WHERE c.asset_class = i.asset_class AND c.timeframe = i.timeframe AND c.watermark = owner.decision_bar
  AND c.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash AND c.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
  AND c.strategy_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
  AND c.created_at <= owner.created_at
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT snapshot_id, execution_profile, universe, policy_context FROM tradebot_parity_snapshots p
  WHERE p.account_id = owner.account_id AND p.broker = owner.broker
  AND p.asset_class = owner.asset_class AND p.timeframe = owner.timeframe AND p.watermark = owner.decision_bar
  AND p.profile_hash = c.identity->>'profileHash' AND p.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
  AND p.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash AND p.strategy_evaluation_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
  AND p.created_at <= owner.created_at ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true
LEFT JOIN tradebot_parity_exit_evaluations x
  ON x.intent_id = i.intent_id AND f.action NOT LIKE 'open%'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT result, matched FROM tradebot_backtest_parity_evidence e
  WHERE e.fill_id = f.fill_id
    AND e.evaluation_hash = COALESCE(x.identity->>'hash', c.evaluation_hash)
  ORDER BY (report_id LIKE 'protection-execution:%' OR report_id LIKE 'batch:%') DESC,
    CASE WHEN report_id LIKE 'protection-execution:%' OR report_id LIKE 'batch:%'
      THEN COALESCE((result->>'engineVersion')::integer, 0) ELSE 0 END DESC,
    (report_id LIKE 'protection-execution:%') DESC,
    matched DESC, checked_at DESC, report_id
  LIMIT 1) e ON true
WHERE i.mode IN ('canonical', 'exit_only', 'manage_only')
  AND (cardinality($1::text[]) = 0 OR f.fill_id = ANY($1::text[]))
  AND (NOT $2::boolean OR COALESCE(e.matched, false) = false OR e.result->>'reportId' LIKE 'protection:%')
ORDER BY f.filled_at DESC, f.fill_id
LIMIT 5000

-- name: ListTaxSummaries :many
WITH filtered AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    -- Let each aggregate read only its own columns, without spilling a shared
    -- materialized copy of the annual ledger (including broker payloads).
    SELECT account_id, liability_delta, held_delta, withdrawn_amount,
           federal_tax, state_tax, local_tax, niit_tax, taxable_amount,
           tax_character, complete, missing_data, effective_at
    FROM tax_liability_events WHERE tax_year = $2
      AND ($1::text = '' OR account_id = $1::text)
), totals AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           sum(liability_delta)::double precision AS liability,
           greatest(0, sum(held_delta) - sum(withdrawn_amount))::double precision AS held,
           sum(withdrawn_amount)::double precision AS withdrawn,
           sum(federal_tax)::double precision AS federal, sum(state_tax)::double precision AS state,
           sum(local_tax)::double precision AS local, sum(niit_tax)::double precision AS niit,
           sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character IN ('ordinary','investment_ordinary'))::double precision AS ordinary,
           sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character = 'short_term')::double precision AS short_term,

SELECT i.intent_id, i.asset_class, i.timeframe, i.reason, i.decision_bar,
       i.symbol, i.direction, i.qty::float8 AS requested_qty,
       COALESCE(i.stop_price, 0)::float8 AS stop_price,
       COALESCE(i.target_price, 0)::float8 AS target_price,
       c.identity, p.snapshot_id, i.reference_price::float8 AS reference_price,
       i.profile_hash, p.execution_profile,
       COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(p.universe), 0)::integer AS symbol_count,
       COALESCE(p.policy_context->'signalEvaluation'->>'version', '') = '1' AS strict_decision
FROM tradebot_intents i
JOIN signals s ON s.id = i.signal_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT identity, evaluation_hash
    FROM tradebot_parity_contracts c
    WHERE c.asset_class = i.asset_class AND c.timeframe = i.timeframe
      AND c.watermark = i.decision_bar
      AND c.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash
      AND c.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
      AND c.strategy_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
      AND c.created_at <= i.created_at
    ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1

WITH links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT supplied.scope_id::text AS scope_id, supplied.symbol::text AS symbol,

    FROM links

      AND p.target_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM links.target_order_id

        target_order_id = links.target_order_id,

           OR lot.target_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM links.target_order_id)
    RETURNING 1
)

        SELECT ts, open::float8 AS open, high::float8 AS high,
               low::float8 AS low, close::float8 AS close,
               volume::float8 AS volume, source, asset_type
        FROM bars
        WHERE bars.symbol = requested.symbol
          AND timeframe = $3
          AND ts >= requested.from_ts
          AND ts <= $4
        ORDER BY ts ASC
        LIMIT $5::int
    ) AS recent
    HAVING count(*) > 0
) AS aggregated
